## DMARC RUA XML Report Parser
**Repo:** n8n-outbound-dns-dmarc-rua-xml-report-parser

IMAP inbox -> unzip/gunzip -> safety gates -> XML -> per-IP SPF/DKIM alignment -> spoofing classification -> health score -> dashboard + alerts.

**Before activating**
1. Bind the IMAP + Header Auth credentials (placeholders in this export).
2. Set the env vars from `.env.example` and `N8N_BLOCK_ENV_ACCESS_IN_NODE=false`.
3. Settings -> Error Workflow -> select **this** workflow.
4. Run **Manual Trigger: Sandbox Test** with `SANDBOX_MODE=true`.

Full text: DISCLAIMER.md · Licensed under the MIT License. License: MIT © 2026 dhRobin Systems · Provided as-is, see the disclaimer.

### 1. Ingestion & safety gates
One item per attachment. zip/gz are decompressed; size cap, DOCTYPE/ENTITY rejection and `<feedback>` root check run before any XML parsing.

### 2. Analysis
Alignment rates per source IP, allowlist (CIDR, IPv4/IPv6) matching, spoofing detection, health score, recommendations. Every failure becomes a `parse_failure` event.

### 3. Delivery
`SANDBOX_MODE=true` stops at the preview node. Live: dedupe by `report_key`, POST every event to the dashboard webhook (3 retries, failure -> alert) and send alerts for spoofing, critical health, parse and delivery failures.

### 4. Workflow-level errors
Fires only when this workflow is selected as its own Error Workflow. Uses `ERROR_ALERT_WEBHOOK_URL`, falling back to `ALERT_WEBHOOK_URL`. Silent in sandbox mode.
